title: Webinar recording available
summary: MacKenzie Brandes presented a webinar on the CMDKP on Friday November 18.
bodyHtml: On Friday November 18, Noël Burtt and MacKenzie Brandes presented a webinar on the Common Metabolic Diseases Knowledge Portal (CMDKP) as part of the dkNET webinar series. The recording of the webinar is now available.
